title: Listing Routing, Claim Credits and Removal Terms by Payout Methods Rail
content:
Payout Methods rails differ on one routing term: whether a single listing's earnings may be routed to the method instead of the default. The other routing and removal terms are the same on every rail.

## Listing routing by rail

| Rail | One listing's earnings may be routed to this method instead of the default |
|---|---|
| Direct Deposit (ACH) | Yes |
| Fast Pay Debit Card | Yes |
| PayPal | Yes |
| Payoneer | Yes |
| International Wire Transfer | Yes |
| Western Union Cash Pickup | No |

## Terms common to every rail

| Item | Every rail |
|---|---|
| Where protection reimbursements and guest damage payments are credited | To the host account's default payout method |
| What happens to a removed method's undisbursed balance | It moves to the default payout method |
| Active methods the host must hold for the default method to be removed | 2 |

## Points of reference

- Western Union Cash Pickup is the only rail that cannot receive a single listing's earnings in place of the default method.
- The removal threshold is a count of **active** methods: a host with 2 active methods meets it, a host with one active method and one method on hold does not.

**Hypothetical reading.** An imagined host wishing to route one listing's earnings to a PayPal method may do so on that rail; the same wish for a Western Union Cash Pickup method is not available on that rail.
